name: Cult of the Arkifane
legend: The influence of Vashtorr the Arkifane spreads insidiously through time and space. His unholy name rings through the Warp like the clangour of smiths’ hammers. It is chanted by Traitors and mortal cultists, who gather to fight for the Arkifane and seek his infernal blessings. Such hosts seethe with biomechanoid mutation and warp augmentation. Tanks, Daemon Engines and Helbrutes are much in evidence with possessor daemons bound within their hulls, haloed by malevolent energies, or boasting helforged weaponry. The traitorous warriors alongside them shudder with technoviral strains and cybermutations. Some bear rune-cursed ammunition that punches through armour with supernatural ease. Others host technoparasitic familiars that gnaw their way into enemy comms and vomit intelligence into their masters’ minds. Wielding armaments forged beyond the bounds of reality and empowered by the might of the Arkifane, these cults sweep across the battlefield to reduce their enemies to glowing ashes.

rules.name: Soul Forge Boons
rules.legend: The cybersorcerous power of Vashtorr’s boons is much in evidence amongst his worshippers. Nowhere is this more true than in the war engines that his cults take into battle, and which exhibit a nightmarish variety of biomechanoid mutations and daemon-spawned powers. Whether wreathed in balefire, shimmeringly insubstantial or constantly regrowing battle-damaged hull plating, these accursed war machines are incredibly hard to destroy.
rules.description_html:
Heretic Astartes Vehicle units from your army gain the Daemon keyword.

Heretic Astartes Vehicle, Lord Discordant and Vashtorr the Arkifane units from your army gain the SOUL FORGE keyword.

SOUL FORGE units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: SOUL-TALLY OFFERING
stratagems.type: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Offering up so great a sacrificial victim will surely win favour with the Arkifane, or go some way toward settling the looming debts already incurred to him.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One Soul Forge unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: BALEFIRE BOON
stratagems.type: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Channelling the infernal flames of the soul forges, this unit tears through its victims with blows and blasts that melt the toughest armour.
stratagems.description_html:

TARGET: One Soul Forge unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: TOUCH OF THE ARKIFANE
stratagems.type: Cult of the Arkifane – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The blessings of Vashtorr flow through these  warriors’ weapons, infusing them with power and mutating them into still-deadlier forms.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding Damned units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.

stratagems.name: BIOMECHANOID REGENERATION
stratagems.type: Cult of the Arkifane – Epic Deed Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Metal and muscle, wire and sinew flow together, reknitting battle damage with sparking clots of repulsive mutant growth.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding Damned units).

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the Soul Forge keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

stratagems.name: UNHOLY FORTITUDE
stratagems.type: Cult of the Arkifane – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Responding swiftly to incoming fire, the bound entity within this daemon engine raises arcane wards to soak up the foe’s fury.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Soul Forge unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: FORGE-FIRE SURGE
stratagems.type: Cult of the Arkifane – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Warp-tainted motive force and empyric plasma flows through engine and living entity alike, driving them on even as it scours them from within.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the Soul Forge keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

enhancements.name: Wyredjinn
enhancements.legend: A repulsive daemon imp of Vashtorr, this incorporeal data-familiar flits through vox-channels and sensor suites, stealing data for its master.
enhancements.description_html: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding Damned models). At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Cybinfernal Font
enhancements.legend: This warp-forged augmetic channels daemonic energies through its bearer and into those they lead, spawning biomechanoid mutation and supernatural resilience.
enhancements.description_html: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding Damned models). Models in the bearer’s unit have the Soul Forge keyword.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Soul Forges
enhancements.legend: This burning rune attests to the – perhaps unwise – pact its bearer has struck with the Arkifane in return for enhanced martial might and lethality.
enhancements.description_html: HERETIC ASTARTES model only (excluding Damned models). Each time the bearer makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Crown of Worms
enhancements.legend: This parasitic helm bestows the ability to conjure daemonic nematodes akin to those manifested by the Arkifane himself. These burrowing entities can reknit faltering war machines or gnaw upon such vehicles’ sanity at the wearer’s command.
enhancements.description_html: Warpsmith model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer’s Warpsmith, Master of Mechanisms and Enrage Machine Spirits abilities.
